notes: Sync is fast and safe: your changes go up about 2 seconds after you make them (was 20), the other side is checked every 6 seconds (was 45) and its changes come down the moment you are not mid-edit (the old rule waited until the cloud was 2 minutes newer and you had been idle 15 seconds — with both devices busy, items only arrived after a pause). Every sheet now merges entry by entry: an entry you changed stays yours, one they changed comes in, and stock figures / rates merge item by item — nothing is buried by the later save.
